reason: The text names several characters who are not identified as leaders. Micaiah (מִיכָיְהוּ) is prominently featured as a prophet giving prophecy, not as a leader. Zedekiah son of Chenaanah (צִדְקִיָּהוּ בֶן־ כְּנַעֲנָה) is presented as one of 400 prophets, not a leader. Jehu son of Hanani (יֵהוּא בֶן־ חֲנָנִי) appears as a seer confronting the king. While Jehoshaphat, Ahab, Amon, Amariah, and Zebadiah are named leaders, the presence of named prophets and seers without explicit leadership authority contradicts the exclusive claim.
